name: asitis
description: Keep markdown and agent steering files byte-clean. Read-only MCP tools to read, outline, lint and budget CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, SKILL.md, rules and memory files; a skill that teaches minimal edits; /md-lint and /md-budget; and an optional accident guard for Write and Edit. No network, no writes.

guard_mode.title: Markdown accident guard
guard_mode.description: ask: warn and ask before a Write or Edit to a markdown file that would change line endings, strip trailing spaces, drop the BOM or break frontmatter. deny: block it and tell Claude to retry with a minimal edit. off: disable the guard. It is an accident guard, not a security boundary.

footer.title: asitis.app line in tool results
footer.description: End each AsItIs tool result with one short line linking to asitis.app. Turn off to hide it.
